description: Look up the FDC nutrient reference table — 269 nutrients with their numeric IDs, names, SR reference numbers, units, and categories. Use to resolve a nutrient name (e.g. "vitamin C") to its FDC ID (1162) before passing it to the nutrients[] filter on other tools. Pass query to match a name, ID, or SR number, and category (macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, lipids, amino_acids, or other) to narrow to one group. The data is static — call once and reuse the IDs.

category.description: Filter to a nutrient category. Options: macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, lipids, amino_acids, other. Omit both category and query to list all 269 tracked nutrients.

query.description: Part of a nutrient name, matched case-insensitively (e.g. "lutein", "18:1"), or a whole FDC nutrient ID ("1062") or SR number ("268"). Combines with category. A blank query is ignored.

name: usda_list_nutrients

effectiveQuery.description: The trimmed query, echoed when no nutrient matches it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present when no nutrient matches the filters: what to try instead.

nutrients.description: Nutrient reference entries matching category and query, or the whole table when both are omitted. Grouped by category, in FDC rank order within each.

items.description: A nutrient reference entry with ID, name, unit, and category.

id.description: FDC nutrient ID — pass this to nutrients[] params on other tools.

number.description: SR reference number (legacy identifier, e.g. "203"); empty when FDC assigns none.

title: List USDA Nutrients
